title: 第218章 西尘落定封疆固振袂东归问中州第217章 渊封永定消魔乱十魂二现启新途
content_zh:
第218章西尘落定封疆固，振袂东归问中州
“第二魂，终于现世。”
墨衍的声音在身侧轻轻响起。
他伫立一旁，黑袍沾染尘霜，肩头伤势未愈，燃烧魔元调和血脉带来的疲惫依旧萦绕周身，可眼底却是千载未曾有过的释然。
“十魂证道，每一道分身，皆对应你一世宿命、一桩上古秘辛、一条残缺大道。第一道凡尘入世，让你懂民生疾苦、守土之责。”
“第二道宗门溯世，将让你亲眼看见所谓正道道统，千年以来藏着多少污碎伪善。”
蔡文姬抬眸望向高耸辽阔的封印光幕。
曾经破碎不堪、裂痕密布的屏障，此刻被音魔平衡之力尽数弥合。
古老符文次第亮起，温润厚重的光芒笼罩整片渊底，隔绝着深渊之下蛰伏的漆黑本源。
魔渊本源并未彻底消亡，只是被双重制衡牢牢锁住，如同沉眠的猛兽，暂时收敛了所有凶性，静静蛰伏在渊底最深处。
“封印只是暂稳。”蔡文姬轻声开口，语气沉稳笃定。
“本源未灭、谍庭未除、内奸未清、九魂未全，浩劫隐患依旧存在！今日安宁，只是下一场乱世的序幕。”
杨玉环缓步走来，裙角扫过冰冷黑石，目光望向深渊上方遥遥可见的裂隙天光：
“方才对战之时逃逸的灰色气息，便是灰寂谍庭的本源之力。千年以来，他们隐于正邪夹缝，挑动战乱、篡改预言、收割亡魂，坐收渔利。”
嫦娥怀抱玉兔，月华轻柔洒落，抚平周遭残余戾气：
“谍庭扎根极深，西境、南沼、戈壁皆只是外围触手。真正的核心势力，盘踞在中洲正道腹地，依托大宗门道统掩护，千年无人察觉。”
妲己粉色妖气轻轻流转，感知着天地间残存的微弱谍息：
“我方才追踪残魂怨气溯源，已经锁定方位。中洲各大宗门地底，全部布有隐秘锁魂阵，用来截留战死修士、无辜百姓的残魂，供给谍庭修炼灰色邪功。”
大乔与西施并肩而立，水系灵力轻轻萦绕指尖，渊底残余的污浊水流被尽数净化。
“西境已稳、魔潮已退、荒原已定，接下来的战场，不在魔渊，而在正道。”

众人所言，与蔡文姬心中预判完全重合。
第二魂苏醒带来的不仅是道心进阶，还有无数破碎的上古记忆碎片。
零星画面在蔡文姬识海飞速闪过：
千年前的中洲宗门大会、清音宗弟子孤身赴会、被各大宗门联合构陷、被扣上“勾结魔渊、祸乱正道”的污名、最终被当众废去道统、驱逐宗门体系。
那道被诬陷、被孤立、被正道背弃的身影，正是她的第二道分身本源。
也正因千年前清音宗一脉被正道彻底污名、断绝传承，后世所有清音传人，生来便被正道忌惮、排斥、打压。
万宗大会的偏见、中洲修士的傲慢、世人根深蒂固的误解，皆源于千年之前那场被谍庭操控的正道冤案。
“我要回中洲。”
蔡文姬转身，目光望向深渊出口，语气坚定，不容置疑。
“第二魂历练之地，在中洲正道腹地！补全第二魂道心，揭穿千年冤案，拔除宗门谍根，清算伪善道统，是我此刻必须走完的路。”
墨衍点点头：“理应如此！魔渊之乱可见，人心之乱难平。魔祸可武力镇压，正道腐朽、人心私念、千年阴谋，唯有溯世求真、以道正心，方能彻底根除。”
“我留驻断魂渊外围，常年镇守裂隙，监控本源动静。一旦渊底异动，我会第一时间传讯于你。”
他抬眸看向众人，“中洲暗流凶险，谍庭扎根千年，宗门盘根错节，诸位务必谨慎。”
“父亲放心。”蔡文姬轻轻点头。
千年隔阂、半生疏离、正邪对立的父女身份，在并肩守苍生、共抗乱世浩劫之后，早已放下所有芥蒂。
无关正邪、无关立场、无关血脉宿命，他们唯一的共识，便是护五域安稳、断乱世祸根。
content_en:
Chapter 218 The western dust settles and the territory is sealed, and the troops return to the east to inquire about Zhongzhou
"The second soul finally appears."
Mo Yan's voice sounded softly beside him.
He stood aside, his black robe stained with dust and frost, the injury on his shoulder still unhealed, and the fatigue caused by burning demonic energy to harmonize his blood still lingered around him, but there was relief in his eyes that he had never seen in a thousand years.
"Ten souls have attained enlightenment. Each clone corresponds to your destiny, an ancient secret, and an incomplete road. The first mortal world will allow you to understand the sufferings of the people and the responsibility of protecting the land."
"The second trace of the sect will allow you to see with your own eyes how much filth and hypocrisy has been hidden in the so-called righteous orthodoxy for thousands of years."
Cai Wenji raised her eyes and looked at the towering and vast sealing light curtain.
The barrier that was once broken and full of cracks was now completely bridged by the power of the sound demon's balance.
The ancient runes lit up one after another, and the warm and thick light enveloped the entire bottom of the abyss, isolating the dark source dormant under the abyss.
The origin of the Demonic Abyss has not completely disappeared, but is firmly locked by double checks and balances. Like a sleeping beast, it has temporarily restrained all its ferocity and is dormant quietly in the deepest part of the abyss.
"The seal is only temporarily stable." Cai Wenji spoke softly, with a calm and determined tone.
"The origin has not been destroyed, the spy court has not been eliminated, the traitor has not been eliminated, and the nine souls have not been completed, the hidden danger of catastrophe still exists! Today's peace is just the prelude to the next chaotic world."
Yang Yuhuan walked slowly, the corner of her skirt swept over the cold black stone, and her eyes looked at the crack of sky visible far above the abyss:
"The gray aura that escaped during the battle just now is the original power of the Gray Silence Spy Court. For thousands of years, they have hidden in the cracks between good and evil, instigating wars, tampering with prophecies, harvesting dead souls, and reaping the benefits."
Chang'e holds the Jade Rabbit in her arms, and the moonlight falls gently, calming the remaining anger around her:
"The Spy Court is deeply rooted, and the Western Region, South Marsh, and Gobi are just peripheral tentacles. The real core force is entrenched in the hinterland of Zhongzhou's righteous path, relying on the protection of the great sects and sects, and has been unnoticed for thousands of years."
Daji's pink demonic energy circulated gently, sensing the faint spy breath remaining between heaven and earth:
"I have just traced the source of the resentment of the remnant souls and have locked the location. Secret soul locking arrays are deployed underground in all the major sects in Central Continent. They are used to intercept the remnant souls of monks and innocent people who died in battle and provide them to the spy court to practice gray evil arts."
Da Qiao and Xi Shi stood side by side, the water spiritual power gently lingering on their fingertips, and the remaining filthy water at the bottom of the abyss was completely purified.
"The Western Territory has been stabilized, the demon tide has receded, and the wasteland has been settled. The next battlefield is not in the demon abyss, but on the righteous path."
What everyone said completely coincided with Cai Wenji's prediction.
The awakening of the second soul brings not only the advancement of Taoist heart, but also countless broken fragments of ancient memories.
Scattered pictures flashed quickly in Cai Wenji's sea of consciousness:
At the Central Continent Sect Conference thousands of years ago, Qingyin Sect disciples attended the conference alone and were framed by all the major sects. They were stigmatized as "collaborating with the Demon Abyss and disrupting the righteous path". They were eventually abolished in public and expelled from the sect system.
The figure who was framed, isolated, and abandoned by the right path was exactly the origin of her second clone.
It is precisely because the Qingyin sect was completely stigmatized and cut off from the inheritance by the righteous way thousands of years ago. All descendants of the Qingyin sect in later generations have been feared, excluded and suppressed by the righteous way since birth.
The prejudices of the Ten Thousand Sects Conference, the arrogance of the Central Continent monks, and the deep-rooted misunderstandings of the world all stem from the righteous injustice case controlled by the spy court a thousand years ago.
"I want to go back to Middle-earth."
Cai Wenji turned around and looked at the exit of the abyss, her tone was firm and unquestionable.
"The place where the second soul is trained is in the hinterland of the righteous path of Central Continent! Completing the second soul's dao heart, exposing thousands of years of injustice, uprooting the sect's spy roots, and liquidating the hypocritical orthodoxy are the paths I must complete at this moment."
Mo Yan nodded: "It should be so! The chaos in the Demonic Abyss can be seen, and the chaos in people's hearts is difficult to quell. Demonic disasters can be suppressed by force. Corruption of the righteous path, selfish thoughts of people, and millennia of conspiracy can only be completely eradicated by seeking truth from the past and rectifying the mind with the Dao."
"I stay on the outskirts of Duanhunyuan, all year roundGuard the gaps and monitor the original news. Once there is any change in the abyss, I will notify you immediately. "
He raised his eyes and looked at everyone, "The undercurrents in Central Continent are dangerous, the spy court has been rooted for thousands of years, and the sects are intertwined. You must be careful. "
"Father, don't worry. "Cai Wenji nodded lightly.
After thousands of years of estrangement, half a lifetime of estrangement, and the opposition between good and evil, the identity of father and daughter have long since put aside all their grudges after guarding the common people side by side and fighting against the catastrophes of troubled times.
It has nothing to do with good or evil, no matter attitude, no matter bloodline and fate. Their only consensus is to protect the stability of the five realms and eliminate the root cause of troubled times.
